# Copilot repository instructions
Read `README.md` and `docs/01-GDD.md` through `docs/08-SETUP.md` before implementing features. This is a Godot 4 .NET RTS with pure C# simulation. Never reference Godot from Domain/Simulation/AI. All state changes occur in a 20Hz simulation tick via validated commands. Use deterministic ordering, integer currency, explicit tick cooldowns and read-only projections. Implement one backlog story per PR with xUnit tests and actual command output. Never fabricate build/test results. Avoid unlicensed third-party assets. If contracts conflict, raise the inconsistency before coding.
